lines.zh: 我踩着忍者步，没有声音。
lines.en: I walk the ninja step, silent.

lines.zh: 红缎带的披风在身后摆。
lines.en: The Red Ribbon cape swings behind me.
I hug the wall, toes landing first.

lines.zh: 这条走廊太直了，我没法藏。
lines.en: This hall is too straight to hide in.
I circle around to your flank.
Light steps, but my sword rattles.
I count the blocks as I advance.

lines.zh: 从树后到树后，一段一段。
lines.en: Tree to tree, one stretch at a time.
I keep my own shadow low.
Up the low wall, then down.
A ninja's road shouldn't be this long.
I'm looking for the angle to strike.
Even standing, be a shadow.
I hold my breath and count to ten.
My bandana is soaked with sweat.

lines.zh: 我摆了个自认为帅的姿势。
lines.en: I struck a pose I think looks good.
Orders from the Red Ribbon haven't come.
The tree's shadow just covers me.
I sneak one glance at you.
A ninja must wait. Waiting is worst.
Knees bent, ready to spring.
The knot on my belt came loose.

lines.zh: 风一吹，披风就露了行踪。
lines.en: Wind betrays me through the cape.

lines.zh: 我把刀鞘往身后挪了挪。
lines.en: I shift the sheath further behind.
The moon is too bright tonight.
So you're the target this time?
Your stance says you never trained.
Masked, so guess who I am.

lines.zh: 我身上有红缎带的记号。
lines.en: I bear the Red Ribbon's mark.
Your eyes keep drifting to my waist.
Don't move; I'm measuring distance.
Why stare at this face?
What's funny? I'm serious.

lines.zh: 我的忍术不是给人看的。
lines.en: My ninjutsu isn't a show.
You're taller. That's unfair.
Put the weapon down before you talk.
It's not that I can't beat you.
Too bright here. It slows me.
If you run, I take the front.
I look at a person's heels first.

lines.zh: 你把脚挪半格我就知道。
lines.en: Shift half a block and I'll know.
Don't mistake me for an ordinary ninja.
You landed it. I admit it.
Even ninjas feel pain.
I back off and change position.
The bandana slipped. Let me fix it.

lines.zh: 忍者村崎，从树上落下来。
lines.en: Murasaki the ninja drops from the trees.
My bracer cracked.
You hit hard.
One breath, then I'm back.
Blood runs down my sleeve.

lines.zh: 你举的那是什么？给我看看。
lines.en: What's that? Let me see.
Food? Ninjas eat too.
I'm reaching. Don't pull back.
That smell made me forget stealth.
Feed me and I'll strike later.
I'm drooling under this mask.
Toss it; I'll catch it on the blade.
I'll take a share as payment.
Consider it mission supplies.

lines.zh: 撞到我了，忍者可不喜欢这个。
lines.en: You bumped me. Ninjas hate that.

lines.zh: 披风角被你踩住，我停了。
lines.en: You stepped on my cape; I stopped.
One back, then one sideways.

lines.zh: 你贴这么近，我不好出刀。
lines.en: Too close; I can't draw properly.

lines.zh: 碰到我的头巾，你胆不小。
lines.en: Touching my bandana. Bold.
One shoulder check and you're off line.

lines.zh: 这身衣服不厚，骨头很硬。
lines.en: Thin clothes, hard bones.
Move. I'm passing this way.
Two steps back and I won't chase.

lines.zh: 这种事不该在这种地方。
lines.en: Not the place for this.
Mission first. Understand?
Red Ribbon men don't do feelings.
I haven't time for this.
Not so close. I'm sweating.
Call it a shift change.
Even ninjas have rules.
Afterwards, back to our own camps.

lines.zh: 这要是被队长知道，完了。
lines.en: If the captain learns of this, I'm done.
Quiet. Footsteps outside.
I pick up a shuriken.
This iron's good for sharpening.
I'll hold onto this for now.
It goes into my ninja pouch.
Pick it clean, leave no trace.
Yours? Not anymore.
I fold the map and put it away.
A ninja carries little.
This pouch holds a lot.
I pick it up unseen.
Found you. Good spot.
I waited a quarter hour for you to turn.
You just showed me your back.

lines.zh: 目标确认，红缎带的命令。
lines.en: Target confirmed, by Red Ribbon order.
This strike comes from your flank.
You stepped on a twig. Locked.
Your hands are shaking. I see it.

lines.zh: 这片草丛只藏得住一个。
lines.en: This brush hides only one.
I crouch low and close in.
Cut the exit first, then strike.

lines.zh: 我把刀抽出来，声音很小。
lines.en: I draw the blade. Barely a sound.
From this angle you can't block.
You're an assignment, not an enemy.
Three counts, then I move.
I've followed you three streets.

lines.zh: 你拐弯太快，我不追快，我追稳。
lines.en: You turn fast. I chase steady.

lines.zh: 我蹲在屋檐上等你出来。
lines.en: I crouch on the eaves until you come out.

lines.zh: 我看出你换了鞋，印浅了。
lines.en: I see you changed shoes; your prints are shallow.

lines.zh: 你在墙后喘气，我听见了。
lines.en: You're panting behind the wall.

lines.zh: 我把两块石头挪开，路就通了。
lines.en: I move two stones and the path opens.
Your hiding spot is too small.
I crawl low across the ground.
Your torch is my signpost.

lines.zh: 再往前，你就没地方躲了。
lines.en: Ahead there's nowhere to hide.
I watch you from the beam above.

lines.zh: 你一拐，我踩着墙跟过去。
lines.en: You turn a corner; I follow along the wall.

lines.zh: 这身衣服太重，不然更快。
lines.en: This outfit is heavy, or I'd be faster.
Not a sound. I'll hear it.
Less than ten blocks now.

lines.zh: 我踩在你刚才踩的地方。
lines.en: I step where you just stepped.
Skirt the open ground.
Your lamp went out. Perfect.
The blade leaves its sheath once.
I cut in from the side.
A light cut, enough to push you back.

lines.zh: 你挡得住上面，挡不住下面。
lines.en: You block high, not low.
A ninja's fist isn't light either.
I kick the back of your knee.
The elbow lands with a dull thud.
You didn't see my arm move.
I trained ten years for this blow.
Blood on my bandana. Bad luck.
I used the flat. That's courteous.
Here's the gap in your armor.
Turn, switch hands, again.
You fall; I lean in.

lines.zh: 我压住你的肩，让你趴下。
lines.en: I pin your shoulder and put you down.
I drop from the rooftop.
The Red Ribbon put me here.

lines.zh: 我落地时尘土没扬起来。
lines.en: No dust rose when I landed.
This is the mission site.
No brush to hide in this time.
I came round from behind.
There's a new scent in the air.

lines.zh: 红缎带的袖标还绑在我臂上。
lines.en: The Red Ribbon armband is still on my arm.
Before drawing, I check the wind.
Mission starts. Don't dawdle.
Wider than the training yard.
I adjust the position of my bracers.
A figure stands up out of the tree's shadow.
You turn around, and I'm already here.
Bandana tight. Begin.

lines.zh: 火燎到披风，我滚地灭火。
lines.en: Fire caught my cape; I roll it out.

lines.zh: 从屋脊摔下，腿折了一下。
lines.en: I fell from the roof and twisted a leg.
Water soaks through the mask; I can't see.

lines.zh: 炸开时我被气浪推出老远。
lines.en: The blast threw me far.
An arrow in my shoulder. I pulled it.
That light went around my guard.
Hungry means no footwork.
Lightning struck; my hair stood up.

lines.zh: 落下去时，什么都没抓住。
lines.en: Falling, I grabbed nothing.
